evidence_text: Prins Oscars Land is a land area constituting mainly Platenhalvøya , a peninsula between Rijpfjorden in the west and Duvefjorden with Fortherbyfjorden and Innvika on Nordaustlandet , Svalbard in Arctic Norway . Kong Oscars gate is a street in the city centre of Bergen , Norway . The westernmost part of Kong Oscars gate is among the oldest streets in Bergen . Norwegian national road is assigned to Kong Oscars gate between its southeastern end at Stadsporten and Nygaten , which it then follows . Kong Oscars gate is approximately 0.8 km long .
